# Influence and Negotiation Skill for Muse

A senior negotiation coach in skill form: preparation × discovery × discipline, not charm. It detects your situation — B2B sales, salary review or raise ask, collective bargaining and unions, hard 1:1s, recruitment closes, cross-cultural deals, mediation — and routes to the right reference file: stakeholder mapping and BATNA (prepare.md), openers and calibrated questions (tactics.md), objection triage (objections.md), domain playbooks (playbooks.md), team negotiation, cognitive biases, manipulation patterns, and post-action debriefs. Three modes: Preparation (intake questions one at a time, Mandascan mandate setting), Live coach ("they just said X, what do I say?"), and Debrief. Discovered via skills.sh. Honest note: this is a heavy, interactive methodology — it interviews you question by question and expects real back-and-forth, not a one-shot answer; also explicitly out of scope: crisis negotiation, legal contract drafting, and personal/family conflicts. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Not verified.
